newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,098 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,098 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 2,098 contracts compared with 1,031 overnight Wednesday.
There were 555 wheat, 706 corn, 615 soybean, 88 soymeal, 28 soyoil, three oat, 28 wheat calls, 22 corn calls, two corn puts, 22 soybean calls and 29 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 4-1/2 to six cents higher, corn was 1-1/4 to 2-3/4 cents higher and soybeans were two cents higher to 3-1/2 cents lower.
